name: auto-hunt
author: Thomas (v4.1 hunting core) / clarois (v4.2 skill presets, v4.3 auto-teleport)
description: AFK hunting from an on-screen panel: attacks the nearest monster, wanders when the area is empty, avoids warps, recovers from getting stuck, auto-heals, and casts a per-character skill preset from your hotbar. Opt-in auto-teleport flies to a fresh spot when nothing is in range. Client-side only - it presses hotbar slots through the app's own client API, so the server still enforces cooldowns, SP, range and targeting. Based on Auto-Hunt v4.1 by Thomas.
